page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine delivered on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz, delivering 4 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. Hardware acceleration features include AVX, AVX-512, and AVX-512 VNNI instruction sets, accompanied by hardware cryptographic extensions including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The server is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It operates without local storage, requiring external block storage for persistent data, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results show balanced single-thread throughput alongside constrained multi-core scaling. Single-threaded metrics, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1549.0, PassMark CPU encryption of 3658.17, and single-threaded gzip compression at 28.15 GB/sec, fall within the middle 50% across measured environments. However, overall multi-core performance sits in the lower 25% bracket, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 3261.0, a PassMark CPU score of 5899.34, and a multi-core stress-ng rating of 3879.9. Uncached large-block read operations register lower-tier throughput at 15.81 GB/sec, though the system maintains stable throughput in text generation workloads using small 135M language models at 105.61 tokens/sec and static web serving at 6.4 GB/sec.

Given its 1:8 core-to-memory configuration, ecs.r7t.xlarge provides strong resource density for RAM-intensive tasks relative to its modest compute footprint. Primary tradeoffs include limited baseline network bandwidth and reliance on network-attached storage, alongside reduced throughput for large-block memory streaming. The instance is well-suited for medium-scale in-memory databases, caching tiers such as Redis, moderate transactional databases, background batch processing, and memory-heavy web application services.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance built on the x86_64 architecture and KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.7 GHz, paired with 32.0 GB of RAM. The instance lacks local storage, depending entirely on network block storage, and operates with a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and zero GPUs. Benchmark evaluation reveals steady single-core computing efficiency, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1549.0 and 6.4 GB/sec static web throughput, countered by lower multi-threaded throughput and uncached memory bandwidth. With an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, the system offers efficient memory capacity relative to compute allocations, making it appropriate for in-memory caching systems, small to mid-sized relational databases, and enterprise applications requiring high memory density.
